description: Issue #91: #201's worktree exists on disk (and in `git worktree list`) but was created after the CommandMate server last scanned, so the first `commandmate ls --json` resolves no id for its branch. The runner runs `commandmate sync` ONCE — the server-side re-scan that exists since CommandMate 0.21.0 — retries `ls`, resolves the id, and the run proceeds normally to success through both waves. The re-scan is not silent: a `worktree_sync_ran` limitation records that the id an operator reads came from the retried `ls`, not the first one. sync is called exactly once for the whole run, not once per unresolved branch.
